sources.relevance: Official two-sided bid/ask definition; complementary NO bid can represent YES ask; midpoint is descriptive, not necessarily fair value; post-only, inventory skew, real-time market/fill updates and cancel/reconcile are standard operating guidance.
Makers pay no venue trading fee. Taker fees and rates depend on market configuration; use actual feeSchedule rather than historical makerBaseFee/takerBaseFee fields.

Rebates require executed maker liquidity, are fee-curve-weighted per market and have a $1 payout minimum. Rates can change. This current page supersedes older /market-makers/maker-rebates search results.

Qualifying resting orders compete for the market allocation via relative size/spread scores. Both sides improve scoring; outside the middle probability range both sides are required. $1 minimum payout; no income guaranteed by merely quoting.
rewardsMinSize is shares; rewardsMaxSpread is distance from midpoint in cents; clobRewards entries are dated whole-market allocations. feeSchedule specifies rate, exponent, takerOnly and rebateRate.
Public GET /book?token_id=<exact token> returns bids, asks, tick and minimum share size. Snapshot script validates exact returned asset_id and sorts prices numerically.

Public Data API /trades supports condition-ID market filters, start/end epochs and takerOnly=true. Sample uses at most latest1000 rows within24h, flags truncated windows, strips trader identities and aggregates recent flow.
Public /clob-markets/{condition_id} provides execution minimums, fee details and rewards constraints independently of Gamma.

interpretationConstraints: Static screen eligibility is not proof of maker fills, realized spread capture, profitability, queue position or adequate queue turnover.
Books on separate outcome requests are not an atomic snapshot. Cross-outcome pair arithmetic is illustrative, not an executable two-leg guarantee.
Public taker rows are observations, not unique global matches or the bot's own fills. No trade identities, balances or private account data were used.
Gamma reported volume and Data API sum(size*price) are separately reported measures; they are not assumed equal. Venue-reported volume alone is a weak proxy for recent two-way flow.
A market reward pool is not the bot's reward. Meeting minimum share size alone does not prove full reward eligibility or predict competitive reward share.
Original historical requested screen uses YES20pp/NO10pp minima; the working tree's modified strategy JSON has YES10pp. Static findings must not be labeled a full replay of either runtime.

The snapshot initially marked gameStartTime as sports metadata; WTI finance markets populate that field too. The screening script explicitly corrects finance markets, and new snapshots use actual sports classification rather than gameStartTime alone.
